name: Ward 107: Silence
storyline: You are Noah, a professional sound technician. What began as a simple restoration of a discarded tape quickly unspools into a nightmare. The recording contains a doctor's confession regarding "Project H.O.P.E”, a government cover-up for barbaric experiments on vulnerable patients. Driven by the need for truth, you break into the abandoned Ward 107. But you are not alone. The government left something behind…
summary: Ward 107: Silence is a first-person psychological horror game. The microphone is the key: use your voice to solve puzzles and uncover the horrific experiments of Project H.O.P.E. Speak to progress, but silence is your only defense when the victims are hunting you. If you scream, it's over.
